EE.reason: Metadata declares 215 units and year 2017, but original and simplified files contain 214; names mix older municipal geography (including Kaarma and Lääne-Saare). The local role is genuine; temporal consistency and completeness remain unresolved.

MT.reason: The metadata says Public Domain but the original d-maps provider states copyright and imposes original-map-URL and 10-map publication limits. A compatible unrestricted redistribution route is not established by the metadata label.
